One installation. More stories.

Your token goes directly to api.github.com for this operation. It is never saved or sent to this page’s host.

What changes and how to restore

The installer checks your current engine and entry page before uploading. It publishes the complete update in one commit and refuses to overwrite newer game edits.

  • Preloads the first scene’s artwork.
  • Waits until Gary is level with the reader and hazards have cleared.
  • Leaves the game world visible behind the sliding banner.
  • Adds the editor and a data file for future scenes.
  • Records a restore point for the previous engine and entry page.

Restore checks that the installed engine has not been edited since. Scene drafts and assets remain available.
